name: Espresso
description: A double shot of our house blend, rich and syrupy with dark chocolate notes.

name: Americano
description: Double espresso topped with hot water for a long, clean cup.

name: Cortado
description: Equal parts espresso and steamed milk in a small glass. Strong and smooth.

name: Flat White
description: Double espresso with silky microfoam. Our most-ordered drink.

name: Latte
description: Double espresso with steamed milk and a thin layer of foam. Add vanilla, caramel or hazelnut for 0.60.

name: Cappuccino
description: Espresso with equal parts steamed milk and thick, airy foam. Dusted with cocoa.

name: Brew & Co Mocha
description: Espresso, dark chocolate sauce and steamed milk, finished with whipped cream.

name: Iced Latte
description: Double espresso poured over cold milk and ice. Oat, almond and soy available.

name: Cold Brew
description: Coarse-ground beans steeped for 18 hours. Smooth, low acidity, served over ice.

name: Vanilla Cold Brew Float
description: Cold brew topped with house vanilla sweet cream that slowly swirls through.

name: Iced Matcha Latte
description: Ceremonial-grade matcha whisked with milk and ice. Lightly sweetened.

name: Fresh Lemonade
description: Squeezed to order with real lemons and a little cane sugar. Add mint if you like.

name: Butter Croissant
description: Laminated daily in small batches. Flaky outside, tender inside.

name: Almond Croissant
description: Filled with almond cream and topped with toasted flaked almonds.

name: Blueberry Muffin
description: Baked with whole blueberries and a crunchy sugar top.

name: Cinnamon Roll
description: Soft, spiralled dough with cinnamon sugar and cream cheese icing. Served warm.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookie
description: Brown butter dough with dark chocolate chunks and flaky sea salt.

name: Egg & Cheddar Breakfast Sandwich
description: Soft scrambled egg and sharp cheddar on a toasted brioche bun. Served until 11am.

name: Turkey & Brie
description: Roast turkey, brie, apple slices and arugula on sourdough with honey mustard.

name: Caprese Ciabatta
description: Fresh mozzarella, tomato and basil pesto on toasted ciabatta. Vegetarian.
